text: @ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity 是 DSH 的 Antigravity 子代理插件，通过注册 provider 并接入 DSH 子代理工具，将独立任务交给原生 Antigravity 运行时。每项任务启动一次性进程和 ACP 会话；用户可配置认证方式、模型、思考强度及允许的模型选项。适合希望在 DSH 代理工作流中调用 Antigravity 处理任务的用户。API key 认证方式需配置相应的 Gemini 或 Google key。

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity adds an Antigravity subagent provider to DSH. It runs delegated tasks in one-shot processes and ACP sessions. Configure authentication, a model, and effort. Use it to delegate standalone work to Antigravity. API-key routes need a Gemini or Google key.
想让 DSH 把独立任务交给 Antigravity 子代理处理。
DSH 能不能调用 Antigravity 来运行一次性子任务？
I want DSH to delegate a standalone task to an Antigravity agent.
@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity 的功能「委派子代理任务」：注册为 DSH provider 后接收任务，启动 Antigravity 进程和 ACP 会话运行提示并返回结果。
@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity 的功能「配置模型与认证路由」：管理员可在插件配置中选择认证方式、指定模型和思考强度，并设置允许的模型或强度选项；运行时会将这些选项应用于子代理会话。
@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity 使用前须知：gemini-api-key 需 GEMINI_API_KEY；agent-platform api-key 需 GOOGLE_API_KEY，缺少会报错。
@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 7 天；提交数 9；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Summary：Run delegated text tasks in **Google Antigravity ACP Server 1.4.3** from DeepSeek Harness. Each task starts a fresh native process and session. Antigravity handles reasoning and tools; DSH manages delegation, cancellation, and result delivery.

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Summary：The architecture follows the official [Codex subagent provider](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1/packages/subagent/subagent-codex). This is a community integration. It uses the ACP Server directly and requires neither the `agy` CLI nor the Antigravity App.

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Summary：| Requirement | Supported |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows x64 |
| DeepSeek Harness | `0.2.1` from rc.3, and `0.2.2` from rc.1; subsequent RCs and stable releases within these series |
| Native runtime | ACP Server 1.4.3 and its matching harness, included in the release TGZ |
| Host dependencies | DSH packages, Cordis, and Schemastery supplied by the host/Profile |
| Model and effort | Native defaults or explicit ACP-supported values; unrestricted by default, no fallback |

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Summary：The compatibility range is `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.2.2-0 || >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.2.3-0`. The latest source review and compilation cover Harness `0.2.2-rc.1`, Cordis 4.1.0, and Schemastery 3.19.0. Each supported series admits subsequent RCs and its stable release without individual registration; 0.2.3 is excluded. This policy does not claim future releases were exercised. See the [compatibility record](docs/ACP-VERIFICATION.md#024-harness-022-series).

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Installing the Bundle：Download **`ashenjyy-dsh-subagent-antigravity-0.2.4-win32-x64.tgz`** from [v0.2.4](https://github.com/AshenJyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity/releases/tag/v0.2.4). Choose the release TGZ, not GitHub's source-code archive. Install it through DSH's Plugins page or the CLI for your Profile:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "C:/path/to/ashenjyy-dsh-subagent-antigravity-0.2.4-win32-x64.tgz"
```

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Installing the Bundle：The TGZ already contains both native executables and their integrity record. Leave `runtimeDir` unset; no separate runtime installation or download is needed. The host must supply a compatible dependency set. Restart DSH if prompted.

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Authentication：**Installation does not open a login page. Configure authentication before the first task.** The default `native` uses ACP's saved selection and enterprise policy; it does not automatically select personal-account login. App or `agy` login is not guaranteed to carry over.

Choose personal Google OAuth, Gemini Enterprise OAuth, Gemini API key, Agent Platform ADC/Express, an enterprise gateway, or existing native configuration. Account and administrator policy determine availability.

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Authentication： See the **[authentication guide](docs/AUTHENTICATION.md)** for Windows login commands, provider settings, and ADC path troubleshooting. Upgrading from 0.1.0 while keeping its ADC route requires `authMethod: agent-platform` and `agentPlatformMode: adc`.

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Configuration：Set provider fields in DSH's plugin settings or your Profile patch. `model` and `effort` are optional; explicit values must be advertised by ACP and confirmed after selection. Unsupported settings fail without selecting another model.

Tool permission defaults to `deny`. Use `allow-once` when this provider should approve supported ordinary tool operations. See the [configuration reference](docs/CONFIGURATION.md) for every field and permission boundary.

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Exposing the tool：The bundle registers the provider and global **`subagent_antigravity`** tool automatically. The [bundle wiring](docs/CONFIGURATION.md#exposing-the-tool) documents the two entries and `maxDepth: provider-managed`.

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · What you get：The parent receives a child ID after native startup and configuration, then an asynchronous completion containing assistant text or a failure diagnostic. Native thoughts, tool transcripts, raw protocol data, and credentials are not copied into the parent answer.

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Failure and recovery： Missing runtime files, authentication failures, and unsupported model settings fail explicitly. There is no automatic task retry, model substitution, CLI fallback, or rollback of completed side effects. For session or credential errors, start with [Windows troubleshooting](docs/AUTHENTICATION.md#windows-credential-path-troubleshooting).

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Understand the implementation：The [architecture guide](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) covers source responsibilities, ACP startup, result handling, cancellation, and performance. Runtime integrity caching, concurrent-check coalescing, stream backpressure, and bounded output reduce adapter overhead while preserving one native process per task.

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Model experience：Give the child a self-contained text task and working directory. It uses Antigravity's own context and tools; it does not inherit the parent conversation or receive DSH tools. See [child requests and results](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#child-request).

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Known limitations and deferred work：One text prompt per session; no resume, task-question UI, automatic retry, or execution deadline beyond startup. Native sessions can persist. App-only plugins are not automatically inherited, and OAuth can require interaction. Full boundaries and verification limits are in the [architecture guide](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#known-limitations-and-deferred-work).

@ashenjyy/dsh-subagent-antigravity README · Dev note：Use Windows x64 and Node.js 22 or later:

```sh
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run pack:bundle
```

See [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the repository layout, build and release steps. Plain `npm pack` creates an adapter-only archive; `pack:bundle` creates the complete Windows TGZ. The adapter is MIT-licensed; Google's bundled binaries retain their own terms in [NOTICE](NOTICE).
